parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description:
Personal access token.  
This field is not required when using an Alibaba Cloud AccessKey ID and AccessKey secret or when using temporary authorization via Security Token Service (STS).

parameters.name: organizationId
parameters.description: The enterprise identifier, also known as the organization ID, is a string that can be obtained from the Alibaba Cloud DevOps access link, such as https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/【OrganizationId】.
